scope: Bounded managed-run dispatch, cancellation, deadlines and retained workspace mutation ownership; local correctness only

checks: complete every accepted tool effect exactly once without queue errors or retry loops
cancel all managed runs, retain exact governor accounting and start only explicit follow-up work
reject a managed run above its configured ceiling before effects
accept a 16384-byte UTF-8 prompt and reject 16385 bytes before effects
run deadline covers blocked governor and pending dispatch admission
canonical workspace aliases serialize writes under two job and dispatch slots
cancelled waiter cannot start; cancelled owner retains workspace exclusion through retained execution drain

limits: In-process gated Provider and Tool fixtures use real local journals, registry and Governor leases
No paid provider, credentials, network, native helper or system-access escalation
Timing is a test result, not throughput, RSS, CPU or latency acceptance
The fixture and executable provenance precede later scheduling and telemetry edits; required final checks cover the combined source
Other native platforms and pressure/quota acceptance remain separate gates

combined_source_revalidation.new_contract: Cached scheduling counts distinguish 1000/4096 managed runs, one active tool callback and all remaining dispatch waiters, then return to zero after drain
combined_source_revalidation.limits: Concurrent development checks make duration unsuitable for a performance comparison; no native execution or platform acceptance claim
